_comment: Own pet icons by the portrait (bug #514, tools/pet_icons.py, docs/hd-icons.md 'Pet icons'). Median XL 2012 gives most of its
summons the face of the class (all ten Necromancer pet types: necromancericon), in legacy and in HD. An entry gives that
pettype its own HD picture: D2R's HD pet icon `icon` (data/hd/global/ui/hireables/<icon>.sprite) with the frame kept and
the picture inside it shifted: `hue` in degrees, `sat` and `val` as factors, `mirror` flips it. The row's baseicon becomes
mxl_<pettype>; legacy draws data/global/ui/hireables/mxl_<pettype>.dc6, a byte copy of the DC6 Median's row named, so
legacy looks exactly as before. `enabled` (file and entry): owner rule, a changed look waits for the owner's review sheet.

shadowspet.why: Summon Shadows: a shadow figure (Assassin's shadow, greyed and darkened)

darklingspet.why: Summon Darklings: glowing eyes in the dark (the Revive icon turned violet)

rampagorspet.why: Summon Rampagor: a horned brute (the Warlock's goatman, reddened)

lamiaspet.why: Summon Lamia: a serpent (the Warlock's Tainted, turned sea blue)

voidarchonspet.why: Summon Void Archon: a bound demon from the void (Bind Demon, orange turned blue-violet)

veilkingspet.why: Summon Veil King: a crowned skeleton king with gold bones (the skeleton, gold)

jinnspet.why: Summon Jinn: a flame-bodied spirit (its HD stand-in is the Fire Golem)

sirenspet.why: Summon Sirens: a sea witch (the Sorceress, teal)

totemboundspet.why: Totembound Guardian: a bound totem spirit (Oak Sage, green)

totemic.why: the Necromancer's totems: a totem spirit (Heart of Wolverine, unused by Median)

overlordspet.why: Summon Overlord (item skill): a fallen angel, its HD stand-in is Izual (the Valkyrie, dark red)

elementalapet.why: Summon Blood Elementals (Amazon): the Blood Golem

elementalspet.why: Ice Elemental (Sorceress): the Fire Golem turned ice blue

thunderbear.why: Summon Thunder Bear (Druid): the Grizzly, storm blue-grey

companionspet.why: Wolf Companion (Barbarian): the wolf (its HD stand-in is the spirit wolf)
